meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)
the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
to send (a person, a letter, a message)

examples.trans: They put bad meat in there for you.

meanings.note: не специально = not on purpose, by accident

examples.text: Ну перестаньте, вы же не специально!
examples.trans: Oh, stop it, you didn't do it on purpose!

examples.text: Я приготовил этот торт специально для вас.
examples.trans: I made this cake specially for you.
I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.note: usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось
goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: There's someone here to see you.

meanings.note: работать + instrumental = to work as: работать мэром

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.
I can see the toy car.

examples.text: Девушки, как я, у тебя не будет!
examples.trans: You'll never have a girl like me!

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.text: Я приехала к очень серьёзному человеку.
examples.trans: I have come to see a very important man.

examples.text: А я испорчу отношения с будущим мэром.
examples.trans: And I'll ruin my relationship with the future mayor.

meanings.note: + 3rd person verb: 'пусть строят' = let them build

examples.trans: I'm with my wife this evening.

examples.text: А ты иди домой и делай уроки.

meanings.en: dear, darling, my friend (in address: родной мой)

meanings.note: родной брат = full brother; родной город = hometown

examples.text: Ну что, родной мой, за тебя!
examples.trans: Well then, my dear friend, to you!

отдыхать.gloss: to rest, to relax, to vacation

meanings.en: to rest, to take a break

examples.text: Вы отдыхайте, а мы сами поедем.
examples.trans: You rest, and we'll go ourselves.
